source.notes: arch-050. External top-k router injected as dense gates into the GSA two-stage slot-summary mixer: router = r_proj(x), sigmoid scores, topk slot indices, renormalized weights, multihot scatter s_multihot; decay f = logsigmoid(f_proj)/normalizer masked f = f·s_multihot, s = 1 − exp(f); then the GSA mixer. Verified against fla/layers/raven.py + fla/ops/gsa/naive.py @ 864a87f6. Layer module: architectures/raven.py.

params.combinator: external top-k router → dense gates into the GSA two-stage mixer (reuses architectures/abc_gsa.py)
external_stages: top-k router (r_proj, sigmoid, topk, renormalize, multihot scatter)
params.structural_finding: same stage-1/stage-2 gate-axis finding as arch-048/049 (stage 1 external, stage 2 typed K2).

coverage.notes: Router-masked mixer parity vs the pinned naive_recurrent_gsa (fp32) and the sparse multihot router invariant (exactly topk non-zero slots) in tests/test_architectures_raven.py; full-layer composition + gradients. Training-time Gumbel noise (RNG-sensitive), Mamba2 decay variant, router_type='mlp', router_score='softmax', feature map, q/k norm, RoPE, output gate and cache/chunked paths are residual external work, not claimed.
